methods.comment:
* Helper method for responding to a session deletion request * *

Note that this method expects that the session is keyed on the mCurrentChildSaRecord * and closing this Child SA indicates that the remote wishes to end the session as a whole. * As such, this should not be used in rekey cases where there is any ambiguity as to which * Child SA the session is reliant upon. * *

Note that this method will also quit the state machine
